# PyTorch Notes

PyTorch has a similar interface to numpy with a bunch of neural network training 
conveniences added `torch.nn`, including integrated automatic differentiation.
It also makes using a GPU really easy. The `torch.tensor` is like a souped up
numpy array.

## API notes

`.unsqueeze()` and `.squeeze()` add or remove a dimension to ensure the shape of
the tensor matches what is needed by the model.

```{python}
import torch

tensor = torch.arange(10)

print("Before unsqueeze")
print(tensor.shape)
print()

tensor = tensor.unsqueeze(1) # Position to add the dimension (col in this case)

print("After unsqueeze")
print(tensor.shape)
print()

tensor = tensor.squeeze(1)

print("Squeezed again")
print(tensor.shape)

```
